rules.statement: The main function of the trial judge in a partition action is to investigate title.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) Main function of the trial Judge in a partition action is to investigate title, it is a necessary prerequisite to every partition action. (ii) Partition decrees cannot be the subject of a private agreement between parties on matters of title which the Court is bound by law to examine.
